question.text: What will Brazil's IPCA-15 monthly inflation rate be for November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves on the month-on-month variation of Brazil's [IPCA-15](https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/statistics/economic/prices-and-costs/17137-extended-national-consumer-price-index-15.html) (Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor Amplo 15) for the November 2026 reference period, as published by [IBGE](https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/statistics/economic/prices-and-costs/17137-extended-national-consumer-price-index-15.html) on 26 November 2026 (release scheduled for 09:00 Brasília time, 12:00 UTC). The resolved value is the percentage monthly rate IBGE reports for November 2026, at IBGE's two-decimal precision: if IBGE reports a rise of 0.32%, the question resolves as 0.32; if it reports a fall of 0.15%, the question resolves as -0.15. The 12-month accumulated and year-to-date figures do not affect resolution. If IBGE's IPCA-15 page is unavailable or has not updated, the figure in IBGE's Agência de Notícias release for the same edition, or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) reporting the IBGE figure, will be used; if the release is delayed beyond 26 November 2026, resolution waits for IBGE's publication.
question.fine_print: If IBGE publishes an erratum revising the November 2026 monthly rate, the value displayed on IBGE's IPCA-15 page at the time of resolution governs.

research:
I found no consensus forecast yet for the November 2026 IPCA-15, and nothing settles the question. The two weekly price indices that overlap the collection window both picked up in early November, driven by food.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: IBGE's own data service (SIDRA table 7062, which feeds the IPCA-15 page) has data through October 2026. The latest monthly value is **+0.32%** (Oct 2026). Earlier 2026 readings: Jan 0.20, Feb 0.84, Mar 0.44, Apr 0.89, May 0.62, Jun 0.41, Jul 0.06, Aug -0.40, Sep 0.70. November has not been published yet; it is due 2026-11-26. [SIDRA 7062](https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7062/n1/all/v/355/p/last%2012/c315/7169)
- The full IPCA for October 2026 is confirmed in SIDRA table 7060 at **+0.14%** (Sep 0.82%). [SIDRA 7060](https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7060/n1/all/v/63/p/last%204/c315/7169,7482)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles or nearly settles the question. The collection window (16 Oct to 15 Nov) closed yesterday, but IBGE publishes nothing until 26 Nov.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-15/14: El Niño risks to food and energy prices are now seen mostly in late 2026 and 2027. 4intelligence sees 12-month IPCA peaking at 6.3% in Feb 2027. The Jovem Pan article gives **no** monthly November figure from 4intelligence, so I could not verify the "about +0.3%" attributed to 4intelligence in the background. [Correio do Povo](https://www.correiodopovo.com.br/not%C3%ADcias/economia/expectativas-sobre-impacto-mais-forte-do-el-nino-no-ipca-estao-se-deslocando-para-2027-1.1764871), [Jovem Pan](https://jovempan.com.br/economia/inflacao-pode-voltar-a-pressionar-no-quarto-mandato-de-lula-entenda/)
- 2026-11-12: Details of the October IPCA (0.14%), according to Mirae Asset:
  - It came in below the lowest estimate (0.18%) and the median (0.25%).
  - Food added 0.22 percentage points.
  - Airfares fell 9.21%, gasoline fell 0.56% (a rise of about 0.6% was expected) and residential electricity fell 1.92%.
  - The average of core measures eased to 0.22% from 0.36%; core services were 0.26%.
  - Mirae warns that meat prices could push food up in Nov-Dec, and that the falls in gasoline, airfares and electricity may not last.
  - [BPMoney](https://bpmoney.com.br/economia/ipca-outubro-014-alimentos-preocupam-mirae/)
- 2026-11-12: A PicPay economist expects pressure from fresh food (+2.84% in October) to ease but persist in November. Analysts note the green tariff flag is already the lowest tariff level, so it leaves no room for further electricity cuts. [O Capixaba](https://ocapixaba.com.br/economia/2026/11/ipca-tem-alivio-em-servicos-e-nucleos-mas-alimentos-pedem-cautela-do-copom/)
- 2026-11-11: The IPC-Fipe (São Paulo) for the 1st four-week period of November was **0.48%** (October: 0.44%). Food was +1.36%, housing +0.13% and transport -0.06%. [Compre Rural, per search snippet](https://comprerural.com/ipc-fipe-novembro-alimentacao-sobe-inflacao-sao-paulo/)
- 2026-11-09: FGV's IPC-S for the 1st four-week period of November was **0.38%** (end of October: 0.32%).
  - Food rose to 1.07% from 0.85%.
  - Item moves: tomato +19.75%, onion +11.44%, airfares +6.25%.
  - Residential electricity was -1.82%, so it is still subtracting.
  - [Jornal do Comércio](https://www.jornaldocomercio.com/economia/2026/11/1269711-ipc-s-sobe-038-na-1-quadrissemana-de-novembro-apos-alta-de-032-em-outubro-revela-fgv.html)
- 2026-11-01: Petrobras raised jet fuel prices 7.2%, after increases in September and October. I found no gasoline or diesel price changes for November. [Diário do Comércio](https://diariodocomercio.com.br/economia/petrobras-aumenta-preco-querosene-aviacao/)

## 4. Base rates and seasonality
How November IPCA-15 compared with October in recent years ([SIDRA](https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7062/n1/all/v/355/p/202110,202111,202210,202211,202310,202311,202410,202411,202510,202511/c315/7169)):

| Year | October | November | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 1.20 | 1.17 | -0.03 |
| 2022 | 0.16 | 0.53 | +0.37 |
| 2023 | 0.21 | 0.33 | +0.12 |
| 2024 | 0.54 | 0.62 | +0.08 |
| 2025 | 0.18 | 0.20 | +0.02 |

- In 4 of the last 5 years, November was equal to or higher than October. The median change is +0.08 pp.
- Applied to this year's 0.32%, that gives roughly 0.34-0.40%.
- This year's October (0.32%) is above 2022, 2023 and 2025 but below 2024.
- Month-to-month swings in 2026 have been large: the average absolute change was about 0.4 pp.
- Recent forecast misses: October came in 0.12 pp below the median, September about 0.15 pp above.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Valor Data or Broadcast consensus for the November IPCA-15 yet. Those surveys usually appear a few days before release.
- Warren: +0.20% for the full November IPCA (from a search snippet; I could not verify the date). Fecomércio-RS: +0.38% (per the background; I did not verify this).
- Focus (9 Nov): 2026 IPCA at 5.22%. The Copom projects 5.6%. [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/economia/noticia/2026-11/mercado-eleva-projecao-para-inflacao-juros-e-dolar-em-2026)
- Kalshi, Brazil 12-month inflation in November (this is the full IPCA, not the monthly IPCA-15): above 4.70% at 0.72, above 4.80% at 0.58, above 4.90% at 0.35. The full November 2025 IPCA was 0.18%. Roughly, a 12-month rate of 4.80% implies a monthly November IPCA of about 0.33-0.35%. This is related to the question but does not match it.
- Polymarket, 2026 annual inflation: 5.00-5.49% at 0.52, 4.50-4.99% at 0.18.
- I found no Manifold or Metaculus market specifically on the November IPCA-15.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-16 (today): FGV publishes the IPC-S for the 2nd four-week period of November, which covers almost the same window as the IPCA-15. It was not yet indexed when I searched. [FGV Ibre](https://portalibre.fgv.br/)
- 2026-11-17: IPC-Fipe for the 2nd four-week period of November.
- 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-23: Focus surveys, which carry monthly IPCA medians.
- Around 2026-11-20 to 25: Valor and Broadcast survey medians for the IPCA-15.
- Mechanics to keep in mind:
  - The October fall in electricity was split between the October and November collection windows, and the IPC-S still shows -1.8%. Electricity may therefore still pull the November figure down.
  - Food (tomato, onion, meat) points up.
  - Airfares: the IPC-S shows them up, after a -9.21% fall in the October IPCA.
- 2026-11-26, 09:00 BRT: IBGE release.
- Weather: El Niño is building toward "strong to very strong" in Q1 2027, according to the ONS (the national grid operator). It matters mostly after this window. I did not find an official short-range weather forecast relevant to prices before 15 Nov, and none is needed since the window has closed.

# Brazil IPCA-15, November 2026: research notes (as of 2026-11-16)

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: IBGE's SIDRA API (table 7062, variable 355) shows the last 12 monthly IPCA-15 readings: Nov-25 0.20, Dec-25 0.25, Jan-26 0.20, Feb 0.84, Mar 0.44, Apr 0.89, May 0.62, Jun 0.41, Jul 0.06, Aug -0.40, Sep 0.70, Oct 0.32. There is no November 2026 value yet. [SIDRA](https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7062/n1/all/v/355/p/last%2012)
- The November release is scheduled for 2026-11-26. [brasilindicadores](https://brasilindicadores.com.br/ipca-15/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The collection window (16 Oct to 15 Nov) closed yesterday, and no figure has been published.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-15: Market expectations for El Niño's strongest effect on inflation are moving to 2027. The grid operator ONS sees a "strong to very strong" event in Q1 2027. [Correio do Povo](https://www.correiodopovo.com.br/not%C3%ADcias/economia/expectativas-sobre-impacto-mais-forte-do-el-nino-no-ipca-estao-se-deslocando-para-2027-1.1764871)
- 2026-11-14: 4intelligence expects 12-month IPCA to peak at 6.3% in February 2027, with food driving it. [Jovem Pan](https://jovempan.com.br/economia/inflacao-pode-voltar-a-pressionar-no-quarto-mandato-de-lula-entenda/)
- 2026-11-12: The full October IPCA was 0.14%, against a market median of 0.25% (XP had 0.23%). Electricity fell 1.92% and airfares also fell. Sources disagree on the food and beverages figure: most say 1.04%, IstoÉ says 0.83%. IBGE blamed excess rain and pricier diesel. PicPay (Pizzani) expects food pressure to ease but continue into November. Mirae flags food and meat as risks for November and December. [InfoMoney](https://www.infomoney.com.br/economia/ipca-melhora-servicos-nucleos-riscos-mantem-selic/), [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/economia/money/macroeconomia/inflacao-ipca-12-novembro-2026/), [BPMoney](https://bpmoney.com.br/economia/ipca-outubro-014-alimentos-preocupam-mirae/), [IstoÉ](https://istoedinheiro.com.br/ipca-outubro-2026-alimentos-servicos-selic-copom)
- **Leading indicator (FGV IPC-S):** on 2026-11-09 it read 0.38% for the 1st quadrissemana of November, up from 0.32% in October. Main groups:
  - Food: 1.07%, up from 0.85%, pushed by tomatoes and onions.
  - Housing: -0.05%; electricity -1.82%, up from -2.41%.
  - Transport: 0.08%.
  - Airfares: +6.25%.
  - The window is similar to the IPCA-15 window. [Jornal do Comércio](https://www.jornaldocomercio.com/economia/2026/11/1269711-ipc-s-sobe-038-na-1-quadrissemana-de-novembro-apos-alta-de-032-em-outubro-revela-fgv.html)
- **Leading indicator (IPC-Fipe, São Paulo):** on 2026-11-11 it read 0.48% for the 1st quadrissemana of November, up from 0.44%. Food was 1.36%, housing 0.13% and transport -0.06%. [Compre Rural](https://comprerural.com/ipc-fipe-novembro-alimentacao-sobe-inflacao-sao-paulo/)
- 2026-11-03 to 11-09: The Focus survey median for 2026 IPCA rose to 5.22%. [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/economia/noticia/2026-11/mercado-eleva-projecao-para-inflacao-juros-e-dolar-em-2026)

## 4. Base rates and seasonality
How the IPCA-15 moved from October to November in recent years (SIDRA):

| Year | October | November | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 1.20 | 1.17 | -0.03 |
| 2022 | 0.16 | 0.53 | +0.37 |
| 2023 | 0.21 | 0.33 | +0.12 |
| 2024 | 0.54 | 0.62 | +0.08 |
| 2025 | 0.18 | 0.20 | +0.02 |
| 2026 | 0.32 | ? | |

[SIDRA](https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7062/n1/all/v/355/p/202110,202111,202210,202211,202310,202311,202410,202411,202510)

- November came in at or above October in 4 of the last 5 years. The median change was +0.08 percentage points.
- The 2026 October reading (0.32) is above 2025 and 2023 but below 2024.
- Monthly readings in 2026 are volatile: month-to-month changes have reached 0.4 to 1.1 percentage points, mainly from electricity tariff flags (the extra charge Aneel adds to power bills when generation costs rise).
- Recent forecast misses on the first print of the month: September came in about +0.15 pp above consensus; October about -0.12 pp below.
- Seasonal factors this year:
  - Electricity: the green flag (no extra charge) is in place for both October and November. That means a smaller further fall than in October, when the bill dropped as the flag switched to green.
  - Food: still accelerating in the weekly price surveys.
  - Black Friday falls after the 15 November cutoff, so it does not enter this reading.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not find a consensus (Valor/Broadcast/Bloomberg) for the November IPCA-15. Those surveys usually come out about 2 to 3 days before the release.
- Projections I found for November:
  - 4intelligence: about +0.3% for the month (from the background, not independently verified).
  - Fecomércio-RS: +0.38% for the full November IPCA (from the background, not verified).
  - Focus median for November IPCA, as of a mid-September report: 0.34%, up from 0.32%. It may be out of date. [SpaceMoney](https://www.spacemoney.com.br/economia/indicadores-economicos/focus-ipca-projecao-novembro)
- Kalshi, "Brazil inflation rate in November": this is about the 12-month IPCA, not the IPCA-15 monthly rate.
  - Above 4.70%: 0.72. Above 4.80%: 0.58. Above 4.90%: 0.35.
  - November 2025's monthly IPCA was 0.18%. For 12-month inflation to move from 4.63% to about 4.8%, November's monthly IPCA would need to be about 0.33-0.35%. That suggests the market expects a monthly IPCA of roughly 0.3-0.4% (my arithmetic, not a forecast).
- Polymarket, 2026 annual inflation: 5.00-5.49% at 52%, 4.50-4.99% at 18%.
- No prediction market prices the IPCA-15 monthly rate directly.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-16: FGV IPC-S for the 2nd quadrissemana of November (result not yet found). [FGV IBRE](https://portalibre.fgv.br/)
- 2026-11-17: IPC-Fipe for the 2nd quadrissemana.
- 2026-11-16 and 11-23: Focus surveys, which include the monthly November projection.
- About 2026-11-23 to 25: Valor Data and Broadcast consensus surveys for the IPCA-15.
- Late November: Aneel's December tariff flag decision. It does not affect this reading.
- Weather: the El Niño outlook (ONS) points to its main effects in early 2027. The excess rain behind recent rises in fresh-food prices was cited in October.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 10 days remain. IBGE publishes the November IPCA-15 on 26 November 2026 at 09:00 BRT. The collection window (16 Oct to 15 Nov) has already closed.

(b) The latest IPCA-15 reading is +0.32% for October 2026, released 23 October. The full October IPCA was +0.14%, released 12 November.

(c) If nothing changed, a repeat of October would give about 0.32%.

(d) Continuing the current trend points to roughly 0.30-0.40%:
- **Food (up):** weekly indices show food accelerating, with IPC-S food at 1.07% and IPC-Fipe food at 1.36%. Tomato and onion are still rising and meat is a risk.
- **Electricity (down):** the remaining part of the switch to the green tariff flag still subtracts, with IPC-S electricity at -1.8%.
- **Airfares (up):** they appear to be rebounding after falling 9.21% in the October IPCA.
- **Weekly headlines:** IPC-S was 0.38% and IPC-Fipe 0.48% for the 1st four-week period of November.
- **Why I shade lower:** in October the IPCA ran about 0.15-0.2 pp below IPC-S, which pulls a straight read of IPC-S down toward 0.25-0.30%.

(e) In 2026 the average absolute month-to-month change in IPCA-15 has been about 0.4 pp. November minus October has ranged from -0.03 to +0.37 pp in recent years, with a median of +0.08. Consensus misses on the first print are typically 0.10-0.15 pp.

(f) No Valor or Broadcast consensus exists yet.
- 4intelligence reportedly expects about 0.3%, though this is unverified.
- Fecomércio-RS projects 0.38% and Warren 0.20% for the full November IPCA.
- Kalshi's 12-month IPCA pricing implies a monthly November IPCA of around 0.3%.
- Seasonal base rates suggest 0.34-0.40%.
